#4201 Password reset email links to localhost
Opened by mkowalczyk on 2026-09-08

I clicked "Forgot password" on the login page. The email arrived within a
minute, but the link in it goes to

    http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…

which of course doesn't load for me. Two people on my team

name: read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The reset password email links use the BASE_URL constant which currently falls back to "http://localhost:3000" if the PUBLIC_URL environment variable is not set. This is causing the reset password links in the emails to point to localhost instead of the production URL. The issue can likely be fixed by ensuring that PUBLIC_URL is set correctly in the deployment environment or by updating the code to handle URL configuration more robustly.
